method: Render the current production LaTeX source and enable tagpdf's built-in finalization timing hooks through l3benchmark. Compile one direct LuaLaTeX pass in a fresh temporary directory. No production source or settings are changed.
interpretation: Writing structure elements is the largest measured finalization step (17.9 CPU seconds). All tagpdf finalization accounts for about 8.7% of this pass's wall time, so it does not explain the full gap to the 120-second per-pass production limit. This single diagnostic pass does not converge references or qualify the production PDF budget. Keep tagging enabled and investigate the larger book sections, especially the documentary appendix.
